headline: BNB Governor: Additional Taxation of Bank Profits May Lead to More Expensive Loans
summary: Governor Dimitar Radev said the additional tax on bank profits is formally paid by banks but its burden may be passed on. Banks may respond through lower dividends, higher loan and deposit rates or tighter lending.
why: Taxes on bank profits can alter lending conditions, dividends and interest margins, which matters for bank shareholders and the wider credit market.
